name: autofire
description: Things that aim and shoot by themselves: every so often the entity picks a target in range among what has a Health on the layers it is for, and fires a prefab (a projectile, from the combat2d module for instance) towards it. A turret, an enemy that shoots at the player, a hero that attacks alone, a guard. How it chooses is a setting: the closest, the one furthest along its path (or the least advanced), the strongest or the weakest.

components.name: AutoFire
components.description: Every cooldown ticks, if some entity with a Health and a Collider on one of target_layer (a set of names or bits of the game's layer list, all by default) is within range units of this entity's Position, creates prefab there with a Velocity of projectile_speed units per second towards the chosen target, and raises action (none: nothing; for a sound). targeting chooses among the entities in range: 0 the closest, 1 the first (the one with the biggest PathFollower progress), 2 the last (the smallest), 3 the strongest (the most health left), 4 the weakest. Dead and Disabled entities are never chosen. wait is the cooldown left. A Disabled shooter does nothing.

systems.name: aim_and_fire
systems.description: Lets every AutoFire entity whose cooldown is over choose a target in range and fire at it.
